entities.summary: Robert Alexander Blackwell is an American former professional basketball player, who had a brief stint with the Los Angeles Lakers of the NBA. A 6'6", 250 lb forward born in Toms River, New Jersey, he attended Monmouth College in West Long Branch, New Jersey.
